privacy.title: Politica sulla Privacy
privacy.s1_content: We collect the following categories of data: (a) Registration data: name, email, company, phone; (b) Usage data: agent interactions, execution logs, performance metrics; (c) Integration data: third-party API credentials voluntarily provided by the user; (d) Technical data: IP address, browser type, operating system, essential cookies.
privacy.s2_content: Your data is used to: (a) Provide and improve Platform services; (b) Personalize experience and agent recommendations; (c) Process payments and manage subscriptions; (d) Send relevant service communications; (e) Comply with legal obligations; (f) Ensure security and prevent fraud.
privacy.s3_content: We adopt robust technical and organizational measures to protect your data: AES-256-GCM encryption, SSL/TLS 256-bit communication, multi-tenant isolation with Row Level Security (RLS), HMAC-SHA256 webhook validation.
privacy.s4_content: Under data protection laws, you have the right to: access, correct, request anonymization or deletion of data, revoke consent and be informed about sharing.
privacy.s5_content: We do not sell, rent or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.s6_content: We use essential cookies to keep your session active, remember preferences and ensure authentication security.
privacy.s7_content: Your data is retained while your account is active or as needed to comply with legal obligations.
privacy.s8_content: To exercise your rights, contact our DPO: privacy@clauthor.com.
